messages:
Priya Nair: Heads-up: launching a short Q3 reforecast cycle and updating vendor approvals. Please read.
Ethan Cole: Action items: confirm headcount and committed spend in the shared sheet by Friday 5pm PT.
Priya Nair: New vendor rule: any vendor where projected annual spend > $5,000 needs a PO plus vendor risk sign-off. This applies to renewals that cross the threshold too.
Samir Patel: Clarifying q: does this apply to infra credits and one-off purchases?
Priya Nair: Yes for any spend that will be charged on Redwood books. Credits where vendor invoices are not issued are exceptions; check with Finance first.
Lina Gomez: Who starts the onboarding questionnaire? Solutions/Product or Finance?
Priya Nair: Teams should start the questionnaire and attach quotes/SOWs. Procurement will handle vendor risk/security follow-up. Link: https://redwood.company/confluence/finance/vendor-onboarding
Ethan Cole: Quick flow: manager approval -> procurement triage -> finance sign-off if > $5k. Expect ~7 business days for full onboarding once docs are complete.
Priya Nair: Card policy update: purchases under $500 on corporate card are fine. $500-$5k require a PO request and manager approval. Above $5k requires the full vendor process.
Samir Patel: Emergency purchases?
Priya Nair: Emergency path exists: 2 manager approvals + explicit finance email sign-off. Log in #procurement-emergencies and cc finance@redwood.com; we'll retroactively issue PO.
Ethan Cole: Minimal PO description to paste into the form: Vendor, Amount, Budget owner, Business justification (1-2 lines), Requested by.
Priya Nair: Notes: attach contract if required, include expected annualized run rate for SaaS, mark contractor payouts as "consulting".
FinanceBot: Reminder scheduled: "Q3 budget submissions" will ping channels tomorrow at 10:00.
Lina Gomez: Product + Eng will send prioritized renewals list by Wednesday.
Samir Patel: Will push ENG items into the sheet today.
Priya Nair: Thanks everyone. DM or reply here for questions. :thumbsup:
